Organization.description: Org name; used in the version-stamp registry path.

FailureMode.description: Lenient = log and continue; Strict = any failure fails the app.

SearchBoxMode.description: Taskbar search: 0 = hidden, 1 = icon only, 2 = search box, 3 = icon and label

TaskbarEndTask.description: End Task on taskbar right-click: 0 = off, 1 = on

ResumeButton.description: Cross-device Resume taskbar badge: 0 = off, 1 = on

OutlookTaskbarPin.description: Auto-pin the new Outlook app to the taskbar for new users: 0 = no, 1 = yes

CombineTaskbarButtons.description: Combine taskbar buttons and hide labels: 0 = always, 1 = when taskbar is full, 2 = never

ShowSecondsInClock.description: Show seconds in the system tray clock (uses more power): 0 = off, 1 = on

SmallerTaskbarButtons.description: Show smaller taskbar buttons: 0 = always, 1 = never, 2 = when taskbar is full

StartTrackRecentDocs.description: Show recently opened items in Start/Jump Lists: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartTrackMostUsed.description: Show most-used apps in Start: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartAccountNotifications.description: Account-related notifications on Start: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartRecentlyAddedApps.description: Show recently added apps in Start: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartRecommendations.description: Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts and new apps in Start: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartAllAppsView.description: Start menu "All apps" view: 0 = Category, 1 = Grid, 2 = List

LaunchTo.description: File Explorer opens to: 1 = This PC, 2 = Quick access/Home

HiddenFiles.description: Hidden files and folders: 1 = show, 2 = hide

ColorMode.description: Default app & system color mode: 0 = dark, 1 = light

ThisPCDesktopIcon.description: This PC desktop icon: 0 = shown, 1 = hidden

UserFilesDesktopIcon.description: User Files desktop icon: 0 = shown, 1 = hidden

ControlPanelDesktopIcon.description: Control Panel desktop icon: 0 = shown, 1 = hidden

RecycleBinDesktopIcon.description: Recycle Bin desktop icon (sets both icon panels): 0 = shown, 1 = hidden

EdgeDesktopShortcut.description: Delete the public-desktop Microsoft Edge shortcut

SyncProviderNotifications.description: Sync provider (OneDrive promo) notifications in File Explorer: 0 = off, 1 = on

ClassicContextMenu.description: Right-click context menu: 0 = Windows 11 (Show more options), 1 = classic full menu

BingSearchEnabled.description: Bing/web results in Start search: 0 = off, 1 = on

CloudSearchMicrosoftAccount.description: Windows Search results from the personal Microsoft account (e.g. OneDrive, Outlook): 0 = off, 1 = on

CloudSearchWorkAccount.description: Windows Search results from the work or school account (e.g. OneDrive, SharePoint, Outlook): 0 = off, 1 = on

SuggestedContentSettings.description: Recommendations and offers (suggested content) in the Settings app: 0 = off, 1 = on

SuggestedContentStart.description: App suggestions/promoted apps in Start: 0 = off, 1 = on

StartSuggestions.description: Tips/suggestions on the Start menu pane: 0 = off, 1 = on

SilentInstalledApps.description: Silent auto-install of suggested apps: 0 = off, 1 = on

OemPreInstalledApps.description: OEM pre-installed suggested apps: 0 = off, 1 = on

SpotlightLockScreen.description: Windows Spotlight rotating lock screen: 0 = off, 1 = on

SpotlightLockScreenOverlay.description: Windows Spotlight lock screen tips/ads overlay: 0 = off, 1 = on

FinishSettingUpPrompts.description: Post-update "finish setting up your device" / backup prompts (SCOOBE): 0 = off, 1 = on

AdvertisingId.description: Advertising ID for app personalized ads: 0 = off, 1 = on

TailoredExperiences.description: Personalized offers/tips from diagnostic data: 0 = off, 1 = on

FeedbackFrequency.description: Windows feedback requests (Diagnostics & feedback > Feedback frequency): 0 = never

DesktopBackground.description: Desktop background source: 0 = Picture, 3 = Windows Spotlight

OneDriveSetup.description: Remove the OneDrive first-run auto-setup from the default profile

RemoveProvisionedApps.description: Remove provisioned UWP apps. Config may override the list with an array.

GameBarControllerButton.description: Open Game Bar with the controller Xbox button: 0 = off, 1 = on

EnableLocationServices.description: Enable location services (machine consent). Prerequisite for DynamicTime.

DynamicTime.description: Set the time zone automatically (requires EnableLocationServices)

StickyKeysShortcut.description: Sticky Keys keyboard shortcut (press Shift 5 times): 0 = off, 1 = on

DesktopWallpaper.description: Replace the default light and dark desktop wallpapers (package\Assets\Branding\img0.jpg, optional img19.jpg, + 4k\)

LockScreenImage.description: Replace the default lock screen image (package\Assets\Branding\img100.jpg)

TaskbarPins.description: Seed default taskbar pins (user can still change them)
